description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon3d/rules/central_D_lon_periodic driven by problems/latlon3d_advection_zonal_central.esm. The problem is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NLON is the open metaparameter (NLAT edge-closed at 5 and NLEV at 4; both axes are passive), and the problem's dlon_deg observed divides by the NLON name, so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. Exact solution sin((pi/180)(lon - omega t)) cos((pi/180) lat); the recorded errors at t=0.5 are the pure centered-difference phase lag 2 sin(delta/2), delta = omega (pi/180) t (1 - sinc(2 pi/NLON)) — the same analytic ladder as the rank-2 sibling latlon_advection_zonal_periodic, since the two extra passive axes contribute no error.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Matches the rank-2 sibling's convention: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 keeps Python temporal truncation negligible against the spatial goldens.
